$comment: Hand-written judgement for every rule the engines emit. tools/build-rule-registry.mjs
refuses to build a registry for a class that has no note here, so a new refusal class
cannot ship without somebody saying what it is for and how it can be wrong.
falsePositiveRisk is a measurement where a pilot exercised the rule, and unassessed
where none did. Unassessed is not low.

palette/premium-consumer-default.appliesWhen: a stylesheet or markup declares a hex colour
palette/premium-consumer-default.evidence: Fired on two of three pilots. Both were arguably right in effect and wrong in reason: the lock console used the colour as ink on a dark ground rather than as a ground, and the seed bank had a legitimately warm paper. Both changed their material and both pages improved. The rule has no notion of what a colour is used for.
palette/premium-consumer-default.override: Choose from the subject own materials, or write the banned-palette-pinned-by-brief line in the direction record. That waiver is only honest when the brief really pinned it.
palette/premium-consumer-default.provenance: the banned palette is taste-skill (MIT), named there as the second-most-recurring AI tell; the check is original
